units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:6">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>דפתיח להו במ׳</he> a legal subject had just been opened for them (for discussion, and he would not disturb them).
<cite ref="Horayot 10b:6">Hor. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אוקימתון מ׳ פלן וכ׳</he> have you put up such and such a web, i.e. have you mastered this and that subject?
